Two features required for the class I ribonucleotide reductase mechanism are therefore absent; RNR-family membership is not in question but the specific EC 1.17.4.1 activity is not supported at the residue level. No structural model could be obtained (see structure_status); the verdict rests on sequence-level evidence only.
